description: Process a opens a table-type recordset on T with option dbDenyWrite and reads a row; process b tries to open a snapshot of row 1 and read it, UPDATE row 1, and open a table-type recordset. Process a closes it and b repeats. Then a opens the table with dbDenyRead and the same sequence runs, ending with a close and b's repeat. Asks which operations of another process each Recordset deny option refuses, at what point, and when the refusal ends.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
